title: extractFileText
summary: Read text from plain text, HTML, and DOCX files.

gpu_support.notes: `extractFileText` performs host file IO and text parsing; it does not use provider kernels.

description: `extractFileText(filename)` reads text from a host file and returns a string scalar. This slice supports plain text files with encodings, HTML files through RunMat's `extractHTMLText` parser, and DOCX files by extracting `word/document.xml` text.
behaviors: `filename` may be a string scalar, character vector, scalar string array, or 1-by-1 cell containing a text filename.
Plain text files are decoded as UTF-8 by default. The `Encoding` name-value option accepts labels supported by `encoding_rs`, such as `UTF-8`, `windows-1252`, and `ISO-8859-1`.
HTML files with extensions `.html`, `.htm`, and `.xhtml` are decoded as text and passed to `extractHTMLText`.
For HTML files, `ExtractionMethod` accepts `"tree"`, `"article"`, or `"all-text"` and follows the existing `extractHTMLText` compatibility behavior.
DOCX files are read as zip archives and text is extracted from `word/document.xml`, preserving paragraph breaks and basic tabs/line breaks.

PDF extraction, website/URL fetching, password-protected documents, PDF page selection, legacy binary DOC, and full Microsoft Word layout fidelity remain tracked by the broader Text Analytics compatibility issue.
Unknown file extensions are treated as plain text files.

examples.output: `str` is the file contents as a string scalar.
`str` contains visible text extracted from the HTML file.
`str` contains the text runs from the DOCX main document part.

faqs.question: Does `extractFileText` support PDF files?
faqs.answer: Not yet. RunMat rejects PDF-specific forms with a clear error and keeps PDF extraction in the broader Text Analytics queue.

faqs.question: Does `extractFileText` read websites?
faqs.answer: Not in this slice. URL extraction requires web fetching behavior and remains tracked.

faqs.question: Does `extractFileText` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It performs host file IO and text parsing.

example.input:
str = extractFileText(filename)
str = extractFileText(filename, "Encoding", encoding)
str = extractFileText(filename, "ExtractionMethod", method)

points: `Encoding` applies to plain text and HTML decoding in RunMat.
`ExtractionMethod` is supported for HTML files only.
`Password` and `Pages` are recognized as PDF-only options but remain unsupported until PDF extraction is implemented.

gpu_residency: `extractFileText` performs host file IO and text parsing and has no provider kernel.
